name: Noble Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. The city wall is to the south, towering over
desc3: twenty feet above you. A single large gate breaks the solid expanse of
desc4: the wall. This is the well-known entrance to the slums, where few
desc5: dare travel as it has been overridden with thugs and creatures of all
desc6: types for some time. Even the city guard does not pass through these
desc7: gates often, their main duty being to guard the inner city.
